gate_scope: design and receipt only; no live DEEP Observer behaviour rewrite
primary_truth_lit_rule: Every Hearthfire surface should glow because something is true.

visual_receipts.state_source: live DEEP packet or fallback slider state
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: The baseline cymatic pattern is derived from DEEP readings, not painted independently.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: Coherence and Resonance set standing-wave modes; Entropy and Motion shape blur and phase; Presence brightens field density; Alignment stabilises symmetry; Horizon derives from the field.

visual_receipts.state_source: pointer, touch, drag, or keyboard activation
visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: User action creates a local, temporary disturbance in the visible field.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: The field changes because the user acted. The perturbation decays and remains distinguishable from the baseline reading.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: Alignment controls how cleanly the cymatic field resolves into symmetry.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: High Alignment sharpens and stabilises nodes; low Alignment introduces skew and noisier boundaries.

visual_receipts.plain_language_reading: The UI labels whether current motion comes from live signal, fallback controls, or user interaction.
visual_receipts.plain_language_reason: The user should never have to guess whether the field changed because the signal changed or because they touched it.

next_review_needed: wire Alignment into the Cymatic Field formula
label live signal versus user perturbation versus fallback state

non_authorizations: no persistent interaction trace by default
no claim that reactivity proves hidden agency or fate
next_passes: accessibility review for reduced-motion, low-stim, keyboard, and touch paths
